facts.fact: UNDP Somalia reports that the Hubiye eKYC platform, formalised by Somalia's first eKYC legislation in December 2024, gives real-time identity verification across 25 integrated services including the entire commercial banking sector.
UNDP Somalia reports Hubiye eKYC verification across 25 integrated services spanning government and private sector platforms, including the whole commercial banking sector.
UNDP Somalia reports that Hubiye eKYC serves 1.2 million citizens with real-time identity verification across 25 integrated services; the document gives no event date, so its published date is used.
